items.title: Adyen Taps Klarna to Enable Agentic Commerce Payment Options Beyond Cards
items.why: Agentic checkout could route BNPL around cards, so assess whether issuers need a pay-over-time answer in agent-driven flows.
items.summary_ai: Klarna became the first non-card payment option in Adyen's agentic commerce suite, enabled without new integration for merchants.
items.take: Agentic checkout could route BNPL around cards, so assess whether issuers need a pay-over-time answer in agent-driven flows.

items.title: Adyen Opens Agentic Checkout to Klarna in First Non-Card Deal
items.why: Pay-over-time options inside AI-driven checkout flows are becoming a live battleground for issuers and BNPL providers.
items.summary_ai: Adyen will bring Klarna into its agentic checkout, its first such deal without a card-based payment method.
items.take: Pay-over-time options inside AI-driven checkout flows are becoming a live battleground for issuers and BNPL providers.

items.title: Klarna (KLAR) Partners with Adyen for AI-Driven Checkout; Shares Dip Despite Payment Innovation
items.why: Track Klarna's checkout reach through Adyen; BNPL options at merchant checkout could compete with issuer installment features.
items.summary_ai: Klarna is partnering with Adyen to bring AI-driven features to checkout, and its shares fell despite the news.
items.take: Track Klarna's checkout reach through Adyen; BNPL options at merchant checkout could compete with issuer installment features.

items.title: Adyen Recruits Klarna for Payments on Adyen Agentic
items.why: Agentic checkout is pulling BNPL into AI-driven purchase flows, so watch for similar integrations that reach card-holder checkouts.
items.summary_ai: Adyen has added Klarna as a payment option within its Agentic offering, though the source gives no further detail.
items.take: Agentic checkout is pulling BNPL into AI-driven purchase flows, so watch for similar integrations that reach card-holder checkouts.

items.title: Adyen merchants can offer Klarna in AI agent checkout
items.why: Agentic checkout could become a new channel for BNPL volume, so watch how issuers and BNPL providers position for it.
items.summary_ai: Adyen merchants can now offer Klarna when an AI agent completes checkout on a shopper's behalf.
items.take: Agentic checkout could become a new channel for BNPL volume, so watch how issuers and BNPL providers position for it.
